title: Build continuity checkpoint publication candidate

acceptance_criteria: P0-013 authoritative receipt is present and true

checkpoint is deterministic for unchanged evidence
no network publication or external destination mutation occurs
production installation and autonomous execution remain prohibited
blocked_by: RCE-P0-013 authoritative clean divergence-guard receipt not yet persisted
